decision: The obvious large-deflection/slope/rotation objection is screened out for these24 checkpoint cases at sampled integration times. This does not rehabilitate the extreme-grid trajectories or certify continuous-time extrema.
next_prerequisite: An independently justified accelerated-freestream aerodynamic treatment or applicable analytical error bound remains required. It must address the imposed32ms velocity transitions and their downstream memory, not merely small normal velocity or structural truncation. Compare S/M/R consistently and establish that uncertainty in the predicted arm contrasts is smaller than those contrasts, particularly the approximately5.6% D000068 effects.
scope: Do not require further repetitions of the same-equation geometry screen now. Its evidence is adequate for its narrow purpose. Keep full acquisition and predictor fitting stopped until the aerodynamic prerequisite is supplied; do not invent a rate limit or substitute another converter experiment.
